directAnswer.en: This is masonry, blockwork or a render coat. The material is mortar or a fine coat, not a structural stone pipeline. At 420 kg this is a mortar sprayer. It does not take the place of a trailer concrete pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Double-cylinder plunger mortar spraying machine at 380 V, all-copper dual motors 9/11 kW, 4 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1850 × 545 × 605 mm and 420 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Electric 20, which prints 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, 120 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, pipe 80 mm, aggregate 1–2 cm, hopper 0.25 m³, 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm and 900 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

heading.en: What the mortar coat has to match

body.en: This is masonry, blockwork or a render coat. The material is mortar or a fine coat, not a structural stone pipeline. At 420 kg this is a mortar sprayer. It does not take the place of a trailer concrete pump. The published Double-cylinder plunger mortar spraying machine row is 380 V, all-copper dual motors 9/11 kW, 4 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1850 × 545 × 605 mm and 420 kg.
body.zh: 这是砌体、砌块或罩面。材料是砂浆或薄涂层，不是结构石子管路。420 kg 的这台是砂浆喷涂机。它不能代替拖式混凝土泵。已公布的双缸柱塞式砂浆喷涂机是380V、全铜双电机 9/11 kW、4 m³/h、8 MPa、水平 100 m / 垂直 40 m、管径 38/51 mm、粒径 ≤8 mm、砂灰比 ≤1:3、外形 1850 × 545 × 605 mm、420 kg。

heading.en: Do not treat it as the neighbouring machine
heading.zh: 不要把它当成相邻的那一台

The shared job site in the photograph does not merge the two tables. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
